subject.title: fix(hooks): bound hook workspace manifest and HOOK.md reads

question: Should workspace hook package.json and HOOK.md metadata larger than 1 MiB be warned and skipped during discovery?
rationale: The memory-safety defect is addressed, but choosing a hard ceiling determines which previously accepted hook packages remain discoverable and therefore requires explicit compatibility intent.

options.title: Accept the 1 MiB cap
options.body: Merge the warn-and-skip behavior because these files are metadata and the limit provides substantial headroom while bounding allocation.

options.title: Choose another fixed ceiling
options.body: Select a different non-configurable limit and update the exact-boundary and overflow tests before merge.

recommendation.title: Accept the 1 MiB cap
recommendation.body: Merge the warn-and-skip behavior because these files are metadata and the limit provides substantial headroom while bounding allocation.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest concrete current-main history in the adjacent bounded hook-metadata implementation, although final compatibility acceptance still belongs to a qualifying maintainer.
